question: Product which has the highest sales
sql: SELECT pm.product_name AS value FROM sales_order so JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.so_id = sol.so_id JOIN sales_order_line_pricing solp ON sol.sol_id = solp.sol_id JOIN product_master pm ON sol.product_id = pm.product_id WHERE so.status = 'closed' GROUP BY pm.product_name ORDER BY SUM(solp.line_total) DESC LIMIT 1
answer: The product with the highest sales is 'The Danala Diamond Chain'. This product generated the most revenue among all products sold in closed sales orders, based on the sum of line totals across all transactions.
insights:
• 'The Danala Diamond Chain' is the top-performing product by total sales value
• Analysis filtered for closed sales orders only, ensuring completed transactions
• Revenue was calculated by summing line item totals for each product
• This premium jewelry item likely represents a significant portion of overall business revenue
• Further analysis could examine sales volume vs. revenue to understand if this product sells frequently or generates high revenue per unit

question: Customer who got highest sales
sql: SELECT cm.customer_name AS customer, SUM(so.total_amount) AS total_sales FROM sales_order so JOIN customer_master cm ON so.customer_id = cm.customer_id WHERE so.status = 'closed' GROUP BY cm.customer_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1
answer: Zenith Jewellers Pvt Ltd is the customer with the highest sales, generating ₹1,192.24 crore in total revenue from closed sales orders. This significantly outperforms other customers in the dataset.
insights:
• Zenith Jewellers Pvt Ltd accounts for over ₹119.22 crore in closed sales transactions
• The company is the top-performing customer by sales value
• Analysis is based solely on closed orders, excluding pending or cancelled transactions
• This customer represents a major revenue contributor to the business

question: Which customer has the highest number of orders which are fulfilled?
sql: SELECT cm.customer_name, COUNT(DISTINCT so.so_id) AS order_count FROM sales_order so JOIN customer_master cm ON so.customer_id = cm.customer_id WHERE so.status = 'closed' GROUP BY cm.customer_name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1
answer: Zenith Jewellers Pvt Ltd is the customer with the highest number of fulfilled orders, with 3,370 closed orders. This significantly exceeds typical order volumes and indicates this is a major, high-volume customer for the business.
insights:
• Zenith Jewellers Pvt Ltd demonstrates exceptional order frequency with 3,370 fulfilled orders
• The 'closed' status indicates these are completed/fulfilled transactions rather than pending or cancelled orders
• This customer represents a substantial portion of the company's order fulfillment volume and likely generates significant revenue
• The high order count suggests a strong, established business relationship with consistent purchasing patterns
• This customer should be prioritized for retention and relationship management due to their strategic importance

question: Tell me all products which has not been sold since oct 2025
sql: SELECT pm.product_id, pm.product_name, pm.category, MAX(so.order_date) AS last_sold_date FROM product_master pm LEFT JOIN sales_order_line sol ON pm.product_id = sol.product_id LEFT JOIN sales_order so ON sol.so_id = so.so_id AND so.status = 'closed' GROUP BY pm.product_id, pm.product_name, pm.category HAVING MAX(so.order_date) < '2025-10-01' OR MAX(so.order_date) IS NULL ORDER BY last_sold_date DESC NULLS LAST
answer: The query returned 43 products that have not been sold since October 1, 2025. These products span multiple categories including earrings, rings, bracelets, pendants, necklaces, and others. The most recently unsold products were last sold in late September 2025 (such as "The Elit Gemini Zodiac Watch Band" on September 25), while 6 products have never been sold at all (showing null last_sold_date).
insights:
• Earrings dominate the unsold products list with 16 items, indicating potential inventory management issues in this category
• 6 products have never generated any sales, suggesting they may need marketing attention or product repositioning
• Last sales dates range from September 2025 back to September 2024, with a significant cluster of products last sold between May-September 2025
• Rings category shows 4 products never sold and 2 older unsold items, representing a potential product-market fit problem
• Most recent unsold activity (September 25-16) suggests these are newer stagnations compared to older products from early 2025 or 2024
